crossRefs.note: For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,
for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.
My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.
Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,
To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?
Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.
We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this…
But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for…
the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,
“However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.
He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,
When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,
for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.
that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will…

translations.web: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.
translations.bsb: Listen, for I speak of noble things, and the opening of my lips will reveal right.
translations.kjv: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be right things.
translations.asv: Hear, for I will speak excellent things; And the opening of my lips shall be right things.
